prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1243; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a rear-end collision involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We ask that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits available under the policy covering the at-fault driver, together with any additional coverage that may apply to this loss. Please also provide the claim number assigned to this incident and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and telematics, dashcam or surveillance footage, recorded statements, repair and appraisal records, and all internal claim notes. Failure to preserve such material may prejudice our client's claim.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
